children: Falcon Finance has a token unlock scheduled for October 2027. It covers about 203.06 million FF, equal to 5.73% of the circulating supply, with allocations for the ecosystem, foundation, investors and team.
The unlock makes those allocations available for sale. Any portion that recipients choose to sell would add to the amount of FF on offer, creating potential selling pressure.

title: Falcon Finance: Unlocks About 203.06 Million FF - Oct 2027
